ORD_STD_GRIDFOLD.note: Ordered score-noise and scale-magnitude sums over a fixed 16,384-lane grid (256 blocks x 64, halving tree per block, then the unchanged 256-wide combine) instead of 256 serial lane chains (8x32). Reached on the fused arm only (random_strength != 0 and no bootstrap: the board's ordered config). New fold order on every vendor; the host column gbdt_oracle_ordered follows it under the same define. Ignores MOJOLEARN_ORD_STD_SPLIT when on. Feeds T24's combine+scale kernel unchanged (crossed). Default ON in IDENTICAL; `_OFF` is the 256 serial lane chains (device and host column together). Grid run ge123e6f9 (NVIDIA L40S + AMD MI325X, full board data, one scored run per arm); PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default by lane/grid-flips-1 2026-10-08 (Andrew 13:00Z); numbers at the declaration and in docs/apple-fast/EXPERIMENTS.md.

LG_LEVEL_ROUNDS.note: IDENTICAL Lossguide exact batch: when max_leaves >= 2^max_depth (parameter test) the round width is the free slots, so one round splits a full depth level (about max_depth+1 rounds a tree instead of log2(max_leaves)+max_leaves/32). Bit-neutral: the best-first replay (_lg_exact_plan) still fixes leaf choice and numbering; same argument as LG_EXACT_ID at any width. Overrides T17_BATCH's width whenever its condition holds (always on board shapes), so the two are declared exclusive; C47_GBDT's memory cap still applies after it (crossed).

CTR_SORTFREE_SUMS.note: Non-symmetric multi-permutation (CTR) leaf estimation without the per-permutation radix sort, gathers and partition scatter: rows stay in original order, per-row leaf ids from the model walk, exact Int32-atomic leaf counts, per-leaf der/der2/weight sums by a FIXED-ORDER FLOAT fold (2048-row chunks ascending, then a 256-lane halving tree; not integer atomics, the walker needs float sums). Reached only on the IDN_CTR_PERM_BATCH batched walk (default on; MOJOLEARN_IDN_GBDT_CTR_PERM_BATCH_OFF disables it). Bits change NVIDIA = AMD; no host column (the CPU binding refuses CTR columns outside SymmetricTree). T18's inherited learn partition is unused under it (all 4 permutations sort-free): exclusive. NOT reached by gbdt-ordered: ordered_boosting's per-task partitions are a device counting sort (_PermPartition.enqueue_sort) on a separate route with its own host column; not converted in this lane.

trees:gbdt-ordered.route: fit: fit_ordered tree loop -> score noise + scale sums (ORD_STD_GRIDFOLD: _ord_std_gridfold_kernel -> _ord_std_combine[_scale] (T24)); host column gbdt_oracle_ordered follows

trees:gbdt-lossguide.route: fit: fit_non_symmetric_tree lossguide exact batch round width (LG_LEVEL_ROUNDS over T17_BATCH)

trees:gbdt-categorical.route: fit: Lossguide search (LG_LEVEL_ROUNDS round width) -> per-tree CTR permutation leaf estimation, batched walk (CTR_SORTFREE_SUMS: bins -> counts -> bin-keyed oracle sums -> per-row apply)
trees:gbdt-categorical.note: gbdt-categorical is grow_policy Lossguide with Logloss (tools/speed_gbdt_arm.py TASK_LANES), so LG_LEVEL_ROUNDS reaches it; the search rounds and the leaf estimation are separate stages (independent).
